verdict.rationale: Extend has a parse endpoint that returns chunked output with metadata. It markets parsing of 'your hardest documents with unmatched accuracy' and offers Agentic OCR plus detection of tables, checkboxes, images and handwriting. However, the pack never specifically documents reading-order handling for multi-column layouts or treatment of headers, footers and footnotes. Missing for 10: documented multi-column reading-order support, header/footer/footnote detection or separation, parse output-structure docs showing correctly ordered content, independent hands-on corroboration of parse accuracy on complex layouts.
